I can’t speak on the use of this app from a subscriber perspective but I do not recommend this app, it has 1 star because I can’t lessen it further.

reviews.title: Not as Advertised.
reviews.text: If you are looking for a free basic remote, this is not it. It is marketed as having ‘in app purchases’ where you can upgrade to unlock all features. No. They get you to connect the app to your network, allow you a few clicks, and then lock all features until you subscribe and pay. You can press the button, but it will not work. Instead you will be met with your options to pay. Pretty dishonest, bad business, and now I am concerned that the true business model may be collecting your data and access to your phone. Yikes. Should honestly be removed from the App Store.

reviews.title: Misleading Marketing: Do Not Download
reviews.text:
This advertises itself as a free app you can download to make use of your smart tv when you don’t have your remote, however upon downloading this app you’ll discover what it actually is: An overtly predatory advertisement for a paid service. 
If you actually want to use this app you’ll discover you’ll have to fork out your wallet first, as any input on the remote will open an advertisement to start a free trial or buy the full subscription.
It’s disgusting that the developers can get away with false-advertising like this, do not make the same mistake I made thinking they wanted to provide the best service available instead of a quick buck off of people desperate to get their tv working.
